inboxEntries.description: I should be able to edit items I've added to the backlog from my feedback form, where clicking a pencil icon somewhere on the card opens it back up in the form so I can edit the title, description, and remove or add new screenshots for it.

inboxEntries.title: Differentiate seeds by plant type in the inventory
inboxEntries.description: instead of just saying Seeds, it should say Roots seeds, Carrot seeds, Turnip seeds, etc., they should take up individual inventory slots and not be stackable, and they should all have distinct icons with a picture of their end product on the seed packet. There shouldn't be any generic "Seeds" that doesn't tell me what I'm growing

inboxEntries.title: Broken down fenceposts are invisible
inboxEntries.description: The broken down fence posts are invisible, leaving horizontal pieces of fence floating in midair. The fenceposts should be visible and not disappear unless I disassemble the whole thing

inboxEntries.title: Wildflowers everywhere
inboxEntries.description: I really enjoy the wildflowers along my walk to the lake, but I think we need them to be more widespread throughout the map. I'd like wildflowers to be essentially everywhere, along lakes and rivers, under the trees of the woods, and in open fields. The only place I really don't want them is in the farm (or anywhere I start tilling soil), or in the ruins of the broken down manor.

inboxEntries.title: Toggle Backpack visibility
inboxEntries.description: I should be able to toggle the visibility of the backpack in my character's Equipped slots in my inventory. For a new "Back" slot under the "Equipped Slots", I should be able to select Leather Rucksack or None, with a hint making it clear that toggling off the pack's visibility doesn't remove the inventory space upgrade

inboxEntries.title: Quit Game menu text is too large
inboxEntries.description: Please make the size of the font and buttons of the Quit Game / Save and Quit / Quit without saving menu slightly smaller, to match the font size of the settings menu would be good, so it feels cohesive

inboxEntries.title: Pointing at a harvestable crop should always display "[E] Harvest <crop>"
inboxEntries.description: Unless I also need to weed the square, right now when I point at a harvestable crop, it does not give me an interaction hint that I can harvest. It should always show [E] Harvest <crop> when the crop is ready to harvest and I point at the square.

inboxEntries.title: Fishing pole and fish icons need refinement
inboxEntries.description: The fishing pole and fish icons in the inventory / hotbar need refinement to match the quality and style of the other tools and finished crops. Fishing also needs an animation of her casting the line out, and the animations should drive the fishing / catching mechanics, not a text box with a progress bar that disappears too fast to read. Draw inspiration from how Coral Island does it. There should also be more randomness to the fishing animation, so it takes a random amount of time for a fish to bite, and the exact moment to click to catch the fish should involve randomness too so it becomes a minigame.

inboxEntries.title: Sleep always resets the energy bar entirely
inboxEntries.description: Sleeping has always fully restored energy in cozy life sims - let's match the standard practice.

inboxEntries.title: Rename Pascoe to something else, non-Poldark-related
inboxEntries.description: The names of the people and places should explicitly avoid directly referencing Poldark, the family names, business names, or estate names.

inboxEntries.title: [Balance UI] Shared ornate frame (SHomesteadFrame)
inboxEntries.description: Source: Balance Agent UI audit, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 (2026-10-04). Size M-L. One code-drawn frame (double rule, corner flourish, paper grain) used across HUD, hotbar, shop and field book.

inboxEntries.title: [Balance UI] Quick-win UI polish
inboxEntries.description: Source: Balance Agent UI audit, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 (2026-10-04). Size S each: in-palette selection outline (not blue); ink ticks/crosses on craft rows; framed hotbar selection; ink keycaps; copy pass (store name, en dashes, date format).

inboxEntries.title: I'm not able to chop down trees
inboxEntries.description: It seems that in the shift from the survival MVP to the estate version of the game I lost the ability to chop down trees. We should still have the animation and sounds - please give me the ability to chop down any tree in the map, and depending on where it is (say, in a forest or far away from the manor or farm), it should have the capability to grow back (we can say it comes back as a fully formed tree for now and defer tree growth rates for later)

inboxEntries.title: [Balance] Something to see along every route
inboxEntries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §9 "Travel times" (2026-10-04). Roughly every 50 m at a sprint (about 10 s), there should be a scenery or forage point: flowers, a stile, a view, a forageable.

inboxEntries.title: New spawn spawned me way outside the manor instead of in the room with the fireplace
inboxEntries.description: It also skipped the name / estate name form

inboxEntries.title: [Balance UI] Meal recipe icons match the tool glyphs
inboxEntries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 icon style (2026-10-04). In the craft grid the meal icons sit on grey photo tiles while tools are flat ink glyphs; redraw meals as flat glyphs to match.

inboxEntries.title: MetaHuman model for the General Store clerk
inboxEntries.description: Instead of the placeholder heroine asset, the General Store clerk should use a MetaHuman model with period-appropriate clothing, and it should be a man in his 50s or so
